artifact.forge.mdtSupplyCart.description:
{Supply Cart}

The Supply Cart ensures eight additional shots in combat. Additionally all shooters in army deal 10% more damage.
artifact.forge.mdtSupplyCart.event: Lucky you, you've found a shiny and unused Supply Cart :)
artifact.forge.mdtSupplyCart.name: Supply Cart
artifact.forge.swordBreaker.description:
{Sword Breaker}

Reduces attack, defence and speed of all enemy units by 25%.
artifact.forge.swordBreaker.event: You stumble upon a merchant, who seems to come from some foreign world. As he speaks to you, you cannot comprehend what he is saying. After a while of searching through some dirty rags and other garbage he is selling, you find some strange looking sword. You take the risk of being scolded and try to pay for the sword with a bag of beans. Surprisingly, the merchant takes it gladly and leaves you.
artifact.forge.swordBreaker.name: Sword Breaker

building.forge.forge.special3.descriptio: The Hero Teleporter ensures the presence of at least one Forge hero in the Tavern (not working yet).
building.forge.forge.special3.name: Hero Teleporter
building.forge.forge.special4.descriptio: The Resource Tower provides you with an additional sulfur each day.
building.forge.forge.special4.name: Resource Tower
building.forge.forge.tavern.description: The Tavern increases morale for troops defending the city.
building.forge.forge.tavern.name: Tavern
building.forge.forge.townHall.descriptio: The Town Hall allows you to purchase town structures and earns your kingdom 1000 gold per day.
building.forge.forge.townHall.name: Town Hall
building.forge.forge.villageHall.descrip: The Village Hall allows you to purchase town structures and earns your kingdom 500 gold per day.
building.forge.forge.villageHall.name: Village Hall
faction.forge.forge.name: Forge
hero.forge.01deckard.biography: Deckard's distinctive armor may look impressive, but it's nothing compared to his anti-magic abilities. No wonder he quickly became the general of the restored Deyjan Army.
hero.forge.01deckard.name: Deckard
hero.forge.01deckard.specialty.descripti: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Resistance skill percentage.
hero.forge.01deckard.specialty.name: Resistance
hero.forge.02kaleh.biography: Holding the rank of captain during the reign of Archibald Ironfist, Kaleh was first one who swore loyalty to the new King. Since then he rose in ranks and now serves as a general.
hero.forge.02kaleh.name: Kaleh
hero.forge.02kaleh.specialty.description: Increases the speed of Thugs or Mercenaries by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 2 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge.02kaleh.specialty.name: Thugs
hero.forge.03polestar.biography: Polestar was raised on the Deyjan plain among the nests of the flying Brain Suckers. Her ability to tame these creatures became desirable in the army of King Kastore.
hero.forge.03polestar.name: Polestar
hero.forge.03polestar.specialty.descript: Increases the speed of Brain Suckers or Soul Suckers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 4 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge.03polestar.specialty.name: Brain Suckers
hero.forge.04codgur.biography: As a trusted servant of Agar, Codgur joined the army of Deyja with his master to create a new world. Great understanding of his kind was a main asset of this cold-blooded Minotaur.
hero.forge.04codgur.name: Codgur
hero.forge.04codgur.specialty.descriptio: Increases the speed of Sky Brawlers or Sky Knights by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge.04codgur.specialty.name: Sky Brawlers
hero.forge.05zhora.biography: In her youth, Zhora left her family home in Deyja and was often changing place where she lived. When she returned to her native lands, she found out about a new king, who was able to take advantage of her Logistics skills.
hero.forge.05zhora.name: Zhora
hero.forge.05zhora.specialty.description: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Logistics skill percentage.
hero.forge.05zhora.specialty.name: Logistics
hero.forge.06tyrrel.biography: After the death of Winston Boragus, Tyrrel with his tribe had to leave Krewlod and search for a new home. As luck would have it, he has joined King Kastore's army and now serves as the commander of Ogres.
hero.forge.06tyrrel.name: Tyrrel
hero.forge.06tyrrel.specialty.descriptio: Increases the speed of Stingers or Bruisers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge.06tyrrel.specialty.name: Stingers
hero.forge.07jonathan.biography: Usually someone as taciturn as Jonathan is rather not a good leader. This time, however, the exception proves the rule and as a result Kastore's army gained a great general.
hero.forge.07jonathan.name: Jonathan
hero.forge.07jonathan.specialty.descript: Increases the speed of Shield Bearers or Pavise Bearers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills for each level attained after 1st level.
hero.forge.07jonathan.specialty.name: Shield Bearers
hero.forge.08lilyam.biography: Lilyam, despite being born in the forests of Avlee, is an expert at digging up resources from the underworld. When her fascination with a sulfur did not obtain approval from the druids, she went to the King of Deyja, who gladly accepted her as a commander.
hero.forge.08lilyam.name: Lilyam
hero.forge.08lilyam.specialty.descriptio: Increases kingdom's sulfur production by 1 per day.
hero.forge.08lilyam.specialty.name: Sulfur
hero.forge.09seldon.biography: Seldon has sailed from Enroth to Erathia in pursuit of adventures and glory. He is one of the few who had experienced the forgotten artifacts of the Ancients in the past. Rumor has it that he has served someone named Sheltem before.
hero.forge.09seldon.name: Seldon
hero.forge.09seldon.specialty.name: Anti-Magic
hero.forge.10vee.biography: Since her youth, Vee was paying more attention to the War Machines rather than magic. Her parents managed to instill both of those passions into their daughter, allowing her to become a powerful Technician.
hero.forge.10vee.name: Vee
hero.forge.10vee.specialty.description: Increases the Attack and Defense skills of any Ballista by 5% for every 5 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge.10vee.specialty.name: Ballista
hero.forge.11albino.biography: Albino lived in the Red Dwarves' mines, where his ability to create fire with magic was very useful. When the mines were populated by monsters, he fled to Deyja, where his talent was appreciated even more than in his youth.
hero.forge.11albino.name: Albino
hero.forge.11albino.specialty.descriptio: Casts Firewall with damage increased by 3% for every n hero levels, where n is the level of the targeted creature.
hero.forge.11albino.specialty.name: Firewall
hero.forge.12marchette.biography: Marchette's hair color is not the only feature others depict as strange. Her ability to excavate resources from the deepest corners was always very appreciated among Necromancers, though she preferred to avoid black magic by any means. Thus, when new rulers have come, Marchette willingly joined the new army, not anymore led by dark lords of Necromancy.
hero.forge.12marchette.name: Marchette
hero.forge.12marchette.specialty.descrip: Increases kingdom's crystal production by 1 per day.
hero.forge.12marchette.specialty.name: Crystal
hero.forge.13mdtAgar.biography: Hardly anyone believed in Master Agar's demise. After hoaxing his own death, the Lich traveled to Erathia searching for incomers from the alien worlds. When he joined King Kastore, he became one of the most powerful Technicians in the entire Deyja.
hero.forge.13mdtAgar.name: Agar
hero.forge.13mdtAgar.specialty.descripti: Increases the speed of Sky Brawlers or Sky Knights by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 6 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge.13mdtAgar.specialty.name: Sky Brawlers
hero.forge.14flamius.biography: When King Kastore made a pact with Eeofol, Flamius was one of the first to replicate the ancient artifacts. His amazing skills in wielding fire were incredibly useful to the newly forming army.
hero.forge.14flamius.name: Flamius
hero.forge.14flamius.specialty.descripti: Increases the speed of Arsonists and Pyromaniacs by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge.14flamius.specialty.name: Arsonists
hero.forge.15daneel.biography: Disgust was the only thing Daneel felt towards his primitive kin in Krewlod. When Deyjan goblins joined King Kastore, Daneel was delighted at the prospect of the intellectual development of his race.
hero.forge.15daneel.name: Daneel
hero.forge.15daneel.specialty.descriptio: Receives a 5% per level bonus to First Aid skill.
hero.forge.15daneel.specialty.name: First Aid
hero.forge.16mdtKastore.biography: Kastore, a visitor not of this world, took power in Deyja after overthroning of Archibald Ironfist. His obsession with the magic of the Ancients has made him aim for restoring the Heavenly Forges around the entire continent, and then to take over the world. No one knows what this demented mind is capable of.
hero.forge.16mdtKastore.name: Kastore
hero.forge.16mdtKastore.specialty.descri: Jugernauts and Dreadnoughts receive +5 Attack, +5 Defense, and +1 Speed.
hero.forge.16mdtKastore.specialty.name: Juggernauts
hero.forge.16sheikleen.biography: Only a few knows where Sheikleen came from and what is her purpose in staying in Deyjan Army. Some people think that she does not care about 'the new, better world' ideas at all and that she has joined Kastore's army only for financial benefits. In practice, however, regardless of her reasons behind this scheme, Sheikleen is a very gifted leader.
hero.forge.16sheikleen.name: Sheikleen
hero.forge.16sheikleen.specialty.descrip: Casts Precision with effect increased by 3% for every n hero levels, where n is the level of the targeted creature.
hero.forge.16sheikleen.specialty.name: Precision
hero.forge.hergon.biography: By manipulating dead or moribund corpses of soldiers by using an ancient magic, one can create dreadful mutants, causing terror with their unnatural look. Though most of them, like Walking Dead, do not show any kind of awareness, there are exceptions to this rule. Hergon quickly became a promising general after his comrades had realized that he can make fully conscious decisions and lead the army no worse than the living.
hero.forge.hergon.name: Hergon
hero.forge.hergon.specialty.description: Increases the speed of Bionic Troopers and Cyborgs by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every 3 levels (rounded up).
hero.forge.hergon.specialty.name: Bionic Troopers
hero.forge.rialdo.biography: Rialdo, apart from a terrifying appearance even for the standards of a Vampire, boasts the magical skills rare in Erathia. When Deyja was taken over by Kastore, Rialdo was an obvious choice as one of commanders of the new army.
hero.forge.rialdo.name: Rialdo
hero.forge.rialdo.specialty.description: Casts Armageddon wwith damage increased by 3% for every n hero levels, where n is the level of the targeted creature.
hero.forge.rialdo.specialty.name: Armageddon
